turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Repetition is key! And how is your ankle feeling? Since it healed up from that hiking sprain, have you been able to get back to your usual routine?

turns.text: Yes, absolutely. It feels completely back to normal now. I was actually able to do a light jog with Dash yesterday and felt no pain at all, so I'm really relieved.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's fantastic news. I'm so glad you're fully recovered. I hope you have a wonderful, relaxing evening baking and hanging out with Tom and Dash!
